description: This file defines an abstract class 'Feature' in the PdfSharp.Quality namespace, providing methods for rendering code snippets to PDF, creating and saving PDF documents, and reading/writing PDF files. It serves as a base class for PDF feature implementations.

classes.name: Feature
classes.description: Abstract base class for PDF features, providing methods for rendering snippets, creating, saving, and reading PDF documents.

methods.name: RenderSnippetAsPdf
methods.description: Renders a code snippet to PDF and saves/shows it.

methods.name: RenderSnippetAsPdf
methods.description: Overloaded method to render a snippet with specific dimensions and orientation.

methods.name: RenderAllSnippets
methods.description: Virtual method intended to render all code snippets; does nothing in base class.

methods.name: CreateNewPdfDocument
methods.description: Creates a new PDF document with title and subject info.

methods.name: SaveToStreamOrSaveToFile
methods.description: Saves a PDF document to a stream or file, optionally displaying it.

methods.name: SaveAndShowDocument
methods.description: Saves a PDF document and opens it for viewing.

methods.name: SaveDocument
methods.description: Saves a PDF document to a file.

methods.name: ReadWritePdfDocument
methods.description: Reads a PDF file and writes a copy, optionally handling password protection.
